request.text:
Clause 3 (Renewal). The returned copy reads: "of non-renewal at least thirty (30) days before the". We accept this change.
Clause 4.2 (Payment Terms). The returned copy reads: "each undisputed invoice within ninety (90) days of the". This change is under review on our side.
Clause 9 (Limitation of Liability). The returned copy reads: "this Agreement in the sixty (60) months before the". This change is under review on our side.
Clause 15 (Governing Law). The returned copy reads: "of the State of Oregon, without regard to". This change is under review on our side.
request.instructions: You are writing for the Provider's deal desk to the Customer's procurement contact, about a copy of an agreement the Customer returned with changes. Use only the brief. Be plain, courteous and specific. For an accepted change, say we accept it. For a countered change, state the position we can agree to, exactly as the brief gives it, and ask for the clause to be put back or changed to that. For a change that is with our approvers, say only that it is under review; do not promise an outcome. Never mention internal approvers, approval limits, playbooks or percentages of confidence.

reply_c1.description: One or two sentences to the customer about clause 3 (Renewal), saying what we decided: accept.

reply_c2.description: One or two sentences to the customer about clause 4.2 (Payment Terms), saying what we decided: escalate.

reply_c3.description: One or two sentences to the customer about clause 9 (Limitation of Liability), saying what we decided: escalate.

reply_c4.description: One or two sentences to the customer about clause 15 (Governing Law), saying what we decided: escalate.

corrected_copy.description: Does at least one change need the customer to send a corrected copy (a change we countered)?

call_needed.description: Are two or more changes still under review on our side, so that a short call would help?

tone.description: routine if everything is accepted or under review; firm if we refuse any change as written

reply_c1.value: We accept the change to Clause 3 (Renewal)
